meta.title: Log in from the prompt: the gated action continues exactly once
meta.requirement: AC7 — after log-in the gated action continues once
steps: Debug → Open log-in prompt → I have an account
Wait 4 s on the Debug screen
expected: Log-in screen opens from the prompt (auth.login) — UI tree
After log-in the Debug screen shows 'The gated action ran 1 time(s).' — UI tree + screenshot
Still 1 after 4 s (it did not run twice) — UI tree

2.observed: back on Debug=True, text='The gated action ran 1 time(s).'

3.observed: after 4 s: 'The gated action ran 1 time(s).'
